newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 13 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 13 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following 13 municipal issues scheduled for sale today:
--Ellsworth Unified School District No 328, Kan., $8.6 million GOs.
--Anoka, Minn., $5 million taxable tax increment bonds.
--Itaska County Independent School District No 318, Minn., $27.565 million school bonds.
--Savage, Minn., $4.97 million taxable tax increment bonds.
--Las Vegas City School District No 2, N.M., $1.12 million GOs.
--Mesquite, Texas, $3.6 million water and sewer revenue bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $5.135 million wastewater bonds.
--King County, Wash., $130.34 million GO refunding bonds.
